target.service: Anubis v1.28.3, -policy CHALLENGE for any user-agent, algorithm fast, difficulty 4

notes: Every request is a fresh cookie -> challenge -> solve -> pass-challenge -> fetch cycle, so each counted request is a real proof of work the server designed. Throughput plateaus around 115 req/s because the Python client (GIL) saturates first; the Anubis server used only ~3 of 56 cores at that point. This is not an effective DoS vector against a modern server; it is a load/benchmark harness.
